name: Blessed Alliance
oracle_text:
Escalate {2} (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)
Choose one or more —
• Target player gains 4 life.
• Untap up to two target creatures.
• Target opponent sacrifices an attacking creature of their choice.
blocked_sentences: • Untap up to two target creatures.

needs.what: a caster-sized mode-owned target spec (`mode: 1, count: 2, up_to: true` -- zero to two creatures) that is NOT the last target declared, because a later mode (mode 2, `Target opponent`) owns a fixed-size target of its own; the stored refs must be split per spec by recorded size rather than by position so the opponent ref after a 0-, 1- or 2-creature pick lands in mode 2's bucket
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Caster-sized mode-owned targets now load (Yuna's Decision), but `loader.targets._check_mode_targets` / `_ends_every_declaration` admit one only as the last target declared -- the last spec of its mode with no later mode owning a target -- since `filter_legal` splits the stored refs by position in `CardDef.specs_for_modes` order. Here mode 2 owns a target after it, so the card is refused. Reordering the bullets so the untap mode is last would break 700.2's printed resolution order and the printed mode order; a fixed `count: 2` forbids untapping zero or one creature; a card-level target would be declared whether or not the mode is chosen; and making mode 2's opponent a non-targeting choice drops the targeting. Escalate (card-level `escalate` with an `or_more` choose_mode), mode 0 (`gain_life` on a player target) and mode 2 (`sacrifice` with `chooser` over an attacking creature the targeted opponent controls) are expressible
